waveform: Waveform of the selected audio track

updatesAutomatic: Check for new versions at startup
updatesCurrent: This version is up to date.
updatesVerified: Download complete, signature verified. The project will be saved before installation.
updatesWaitJobs: Finish or cancel processing jobs before installation.
updatesError: Checking, downloading or installation failed. Retry when the connection is available.
updatesHint: Updates come from the studio GitHub repository and their signature is verified. Installation starts only at your request.
playbackMetricsHint: These counters describe video playback since loading. If playback stutters, prepare a smooth preview in Audio and compare the results.
lightPreviewHint: Create an H.264 preview limited to 720p and 30 fps, with frequent keyframes for faster seeking. The original video is retained.
separationHint: Bandit v2 Multilingual extracts speech, music and effects from the track selected at import. Processing stays on this device.
runtimeHint: Install Python and dependencies in the studio data folder, then the 447 MB model. Allow about 2 GB for CPU mode and more for CUDA. Weights: CC BY-SA 4.0; Bandit code: Apache-2.0.
runtimeModify: Modify or repair the Bandit installation
runtimeDeviceUnavailable: {{name}} is detected but cannot run CUDA operations. Reinstall NVIDIA support and check the driver.
separationQuality: Separation is an estimate and may contain leakage or artifacts. A film may take a long time on CPU. Results appear in the timeline on success; previous outputs are retained.
mixerHint: The enabled speaker activates a track; the crossed speaker mutes it. S solos a track. Player volume controls the master level. After separation, stems replace the original soundtrack.
charactersHint: Identify voices automatically, then name characters and correct their lines.
speakerHint: Local voice analysis of existing subtitle intervals. Uses the Bandit speech track when available. Review the proposals and enter character names manually.
speakerThresholdHint: Higher values create more groups. Short, noisy or overlapping voices may produce errors.
speakerApplyHint: Creates Speaker 1, Speaker 2… characters with a voice reference. Manually assigned lines keep their character.
speakerStale: Lines or media have changed. Run identification again before applying.
charactersEmpty: Create a character, or run AI identification after importing your subtitles.
voiceReferenceHint: Import a clear single-voice clip or extract the selected line. Maximum 20 seconds. Add several references, such as neutral, angry or whisper.
modelsHint: Install available engines below. Preferences for future engines are listed separately.
modelBanditHint: Speech, music and effects separation. Verified multilingual 447 MB model.
modelConfigureBandit: Install or configure Bandit in Audio
modelSpeakerHint: Groups subtitle voices with CAMPPlus and filters speech with Silero. Isolated installation with verified files and checksums.
voiceStatusHint: No audio take selected for this line. Click Dub to choose an engine and generate a voice.
modelVoiceHint: CosyVoice3, Fish S2 and Qwen3-TTS are available in Dubbing. Install the matching variant above.

autoAlignImported: Automatically synchronize the imported SRT with the other SRT

subtitleImportedAlignmentSkipped: SRT imported. Automatic synchronization was not applied:
modelStorageHint: Choose a local folder. Bandit, speaker and CosyVoice3 models, downloads and Python environments move together. Copies are verified before switching the active folder. Allow space for a full copy at the destination.
modelStorageMoved: Models moved. The new folder is active.
modelStorageCleanupWarning: The new folder is active, but some files could not be removed from the old folder. See the Processing logs.
voiceVariantsHint: GGUF Q8_0 variants with audio.cpp and Fish FP8 are integrated. Other formats remain documented for future integration.
voiceVariants16Gb: For 16 GB VRAM, prefer a small model or a quantized profile. Actual memory depends on the engine, context and batch; file size is not VRAM. Candidates are not yet qualified on your GPU.
variantNotIntegrated: Engine and variant are not yet integrated in the studio.
variantReportedVram: VRAM reported by the source: approximately {{gb}} GB.
variantExceeds16Gb: Exceeds the capacity of a 16 GB card.

variantDetails.cosyOfficial: Small official 0.5B model; a starting point for the CosyVoice engine. The studio does not guarantee a VRAM figure.
variantDetails.cosyGguf: cstr conversion: Q4_K talker and Q8_0 flow. Approximately 745 MB of weights for preset voices; cloning also requires the tokenizer and speaker encoder. Requires the compatible CrispASR engine.
variantDetails.fishFp8: drbaph FP8 conversion with BF16 activations. Requires a specific FP8Linear loader; the official engine alone is insufficient. Fish Audio Research license.
variantDetails.fishGguf: rodrigomt Q6_K conversion, approximately 4.3 GB file size. Requires the experimental community s2.cpp engine. Fish Audio Research license.
variantDetails.fishGgufSmall: rodrigomt Q4_K_M conversion, approximately 3.4 GB file size, with stronger quantization. Requires experimental s2.cpp; compare quality with Q6_K. Fish Audio Research license.
variantDetails.fishFull: Official BF16 weights. Fish recommends 24 GB for S2 Pro; prefer a smaller variant with 16 GB. Fish Audio Research license.
variantDetails.qwenSmall: Official Base 0.6B BF16 voice-cloning model, with fewer parameters than 1.7B. Plan one loaded model and one subtitle at a time during integration.
variantDetails.qwenFull: Official Base 1.7B BF16 voice-cloning model. Complete engine memory remains to be measured; 0.6B and the GGUF profile are lighter alternatives.
variantDetails.qwenGguf: HaujetZhao project: Q5_K talker, Q8_0 predictor and ONNX FP16 components. Converted from official weights; the complete hybrid engine is needed, rather than opening one GGUF in an LLM player.
variantDetails.phase6Gguf: audio.cpp 0.9.1: GGUF Q8_0 weights, Vulkan on the selected GPU or CPU. Automatic mode prefers a discrete GPU. Model files also include the speech codec.

quickAudioHint: Make all audible enables tracks, clears solos and temporarily bypasses regions. Volumes are preserved. Reapply regions restores the edit.
audioRegionsHint: Choose timecodes or Shift-drag on a timeline audio track. New regions replace overlapping ranges. Outside regions, the track remains audible.
isolateRegionHint: Replaces this track’s regions with listening limited to the selection. Undo with Ctrl+Z.
regionSaved: Region saved. Track settings retain priority.
regionGainHint: Heard volume = master × track × region volume. Muted tracks or tracks excluded by solo remain silent. Edited exports of separated tracks include track gain and regions; solo and master volume are player settings.
modelStorageSizeHint: Sum of file sizes in the folder, without following symbolic links or junctions. Actual allocated disk space may differ.
ttsModelHint: Local speech synthesis from text and a voice reference. Official 0.5B RL weights; FP16 on CUDA, FP32 on CPU. One AI task at a time.
ttsInstallCuda: Install CUDA 12.8 for NVIDIA RTX GPUs (including RTX 5060 Ti)
ttsLocalHint: Each generation creates a new take without overwriting older ones. The model unloads afterwards to release VRAM. WAV listening is independent from video playback.
ttsNeedsInstallation: Install the selected variant from Models to generate a line.
ttsDeviceAuto: Automatic: available discrete GPU, otherwise CPU
ttsCurrentReferenceHint: Extracts 1–20 seconds; uses the separated Speech track when available, otherwise source audio.
ttsReferenceMissing: Assign a character and choose a voice reference.
ttsCrossHint: Suitable for Japanese reference speech and French output. No reference transcript is required.
ttsZeroHint: The transcript must match the words spoken in the reference, in its original language.
ttsEditPronunciationHint: Edit this text in the line’s Pronunciation tab. Text and punctuation influence language and rhythm.
ttsReferenceTooShort: The reference must last at least one second; prefer several seconds of clear speech.
ttsStale: Text, timing or character changed since this take.
ttsTooLong: Speech exceeds the slot. Adjust text or speed and generate another take.
ttsListenDub: Listen to the selected dubbing take
ttsVariantReady: Integrated variant: install in Models and select in Dubbing.
phase6Profiles: 16 GB profiles: start with Qwen3-TTS 0.6B GGUF. Only one engine loads at a time. Actual VRAM depends on text and reference; these profiles still need validation on your RTX.
phase6Gguf: audio.cpp 0.9.1: GGUF Q8_0 weights, Vulkan on the selected GPU or CPU. Automatic mode prefers a discrete GPU. Model files also include the speech codec.
phase6Fp8: FP8 E4M3 weights and BF16 activations with the Fish loader. Requires CUDA 12.8, an NVIDIA BF16 GPU and at least 12 GiB free VRAM. Close other AI applications. Isolated Python installation.
phase6FishLicense: Fish Audio Research License: non-commercial use; commercial use requires a separate license.
phase6ModelSize: model only; engine and dependencies are additional
dubbingMixHint: Enables dubbing, music and effects; mutes the original voices. Press Play next. Track levels and regions remain editable.
exportMkvHint: Copies the original video without re-encoding. The studio mix becomes the default audio track; subtitles remain selectable in your player.
mixNaturalLength: Takes start at their dialogue’s start and keep their natural duration. Overlaps are mixed together; audio ends with the video.
mixReview: Review: {{missing}} lines without voices, {{stale}} takes changed since generation, {{long}} takes exceeding their dialogue.
mixAcceptReview: Export this edit despite missing or unreviewed lines
mixOriginalWarning: Original voices are audible in the mix. Use “Prepare dubbing mix” to mute them.
mixNoStems: To keep music and effects without the original voices, run separation in Audio first.
mixExportLevels: Export uses the mixer’s mutes, solos, gains and regions. Player monitoring volume does not affect export. Peaks above 0 dB are clipped: lower levels if needed.

mkv.includeOriginal: Also keep the original audio track unchanged
